get.description:
Read the saved editable draft, including blocks, edges, loop and parallel containers, and variables. Requires workspace read access. Configured values are included; use this state with Replace workflow state for same-workspace editing, or Export workflow for portable data with registered credential fields cleared. This read records no audit event; `HEAD` mirrors `GET`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

put.description:
Replace the draft graph in one write. Requires workspace write access. Concurrent row-locked writes are last-write-wins; IDs owned by another workflow return `409`. Deployments, schedules, and webhook registrations are unchanged. Deploy to serve the edits.

Lint is advisory. Use `dryRun=true` to validate without saving, auditing, or notifying collaborators. Workspace API keys return `403`; use a personal API key or scoped OAuth token.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Validate and lint without writing, auditing, or notifying collaborators. Returns the same validation, preparation warnings, lint findings, and ID-ownership conflicts (`409`) as a committed write. `needsRedeployment` describes the pre-write state. For semantic operations, `mintedBlockIds` is empty; `previewBlockIds` contains provisional IDs with a warning, since committing mints new IDs.

requestBody.description: A complete replacement draft graph for a workflow.

post.description:
Apply draft edits and block enablement changes in one write. Requires workspace write access. The live deployment is unchanged; lint is advisory.

Inspect `skipped` and `inputValidationErrors` for edits that did not apply. Deferred edges apply when their targets exist; do not resubmit them. With `atomic=true`, declined operations or dropped inputs return `409` (`OPERATIONS_NOT_APPLIED`) without saving. Use returned `mintedBlockIds` in later requests. `dryRun=true` evaluates without saving, auditing, or notifying. Workspace API keys return `403`; use a personal API key or scoped OAuth token.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

`/workflows/{workflowId}/deployment` controls overall API executability; `/deployments/chat` controls only the hosted-chat surface. A workflow can remain deployed without a chat.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

post.description:
Create a deployment version and activate it asynchronously. Requires workspace Admin access. Each accepted deploy creates a new version; retrying after a timeout can create a duplicate. Poll Get workflow deployment for the accepted `latestDeploymentAttempt` before treating the version as live.

`lint` reports advisory findings for this version and never blocks deployment. A conflicting webhook path returns `409`. Workspace API keys return `403`; use a personal API key or scoped OAuth token.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

delete.description:

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

requestBody.description: Optional deployment version to reactivate.

get.description:
Export the saved draft as portable workflow data with workspace read access. Registered credential fields and opaque table/tool values are cleared; environment references and ordinary workflow variables remain included. Review other configuration before sharing.

Default exports clear workspace bindings. Use `includeWorkspaceBindings=true` to retain non-secret bindings for a same-workspace import, or `includeReferences=true` for source identities and field occurrences used by mapped imports. Exporting records an audit event. `HEAD` checks access with the same authorization as `GET` but skips side effects, returning an empty `200` without payload headers on success. Workspace folder trees exceeding 10,000 folders return `413`.

OAuth scope: `api:read`.

post.description:
Run the active deployment, or set `run.source: "manual"` to run the saved draft. Deployed execution requires workspace read access and OAuth `api:write` scope or an API key; public deployments also allow anonymous synchronous or streamed runs. Manual runs require personal-key or OAuth write access and cannot be async.

Use `async: true` for a queue receipt, or `stream: true` for SSE. For a synchronous run with both flags false, send `Accept: application/x-ndjson` for heartbeat frames and a final frame containing `data`. Timeouts return `200` with `status: "failed"` and `error.code: "TIMEOUT"`; inspect run status. See [Streaming](/workflows/deployment/api#streaming) for event formats. Input descriptions specify compatible modes; invalid combinations return `400`.

Supply `X-Run-Id` to prevent duplicate execution. Reuse returns `409`, without replaying results. A `503` with `error.details.code: "ASYNC_ENQUEUE_AMBIGUOUS"` omits `Retry-After` because the run may already have started. Reconcile using the returned run ID; do not start another run with a new or omitted ID.

OAuth scope: `api:write`.

parameters.name: x-run-id
parameters.description: Run ID for API-key or OAuth callers; ignored for anonymous requests. Reuse it after an uncertain response: a claimed ID returns `409` with `RUN_ID_CONFLICT`, without replaying results. Check Get workflow run, but `404` can persist while the ID remains claimed and does not establish whether execution started. Do not automatically restart with a fresh or omitted ID; either can start another run.

get.description:

Expired runs are permanently deleted by retention cleanup. Sim Cloud Free defaults to 30 days from run start; paid plans and billing-disabled deployments have no default expiry.
